runtime: Command-line DOM emulation + web-audio-engine 0.13.4; not native browser verification

tests.name: Catalog loading is lazy and keeps cancel controls outside the locked editor
Doubling BPM halves time and doubles source rate; pitch changes source rate only
Mono choke preserves simultaneous layers and truncates the previous hit
Reject corrupt time, pitch, gain, and source identity before scheduling
Load an arrangement, retain per-note edits in session JSON, and resolve all sample dependencies
Edited reference identity cannot enter the candidate audio graph
Out-of-range source cuts fail explicitly
Independent expected PCM passes; replacing the candidate with silence fails
Stereo channel inversion cannot pass a waveform gate
Changing A/B side never changes the offline candidate render
Repitched hits start at the right rate inside a native audio render block
A/B shares one clock while the grid and source marker follow the active chop
Audible test queues keep their A/B switch and stop control operable
Save WAV exports an arrangement even when the legacy step pattern is empty
Session MD5 mismatch is rejected before audio loading
Audio tampering is rejected against the session hash
Duplicate catalog IDs, duplicate queue IDs, disabled and missing cases are rejected
Cancellation aborts loading and marks every unfinished queue item cancelled
Export ZIP round-trips catalog, pinned session, and external audio
Legacy mono choke is also applied in offline rendering
Non-finite PCM cannot produce a misleading comparison report
External manifests bind session and every audio identity at their own relative URL
Bundle-relative catalog, session, and audio load without network requests
A nonzero attack holds its sustain level between the two fades
Clearing the sample clears timed arrangement state and restores the grid
A chop budget rejects an eleventh region and undeclared per-hit boundaries
Automation validates bounds, ordering, and a finite feedback range
Linear envelope interpolation and tempo scaling preserve automation time
Cleared sends leave dry PCM unchanged
Delay repeats arrive at the chosen beat interval with decreasing amplitudes
A send ramp changes successive hit echoes without changing dry hits
Reverb produces deterministic delayed energy and clears completely
Lane API, keyboard edit, clear, and source kit persist in session JSON
The musical kit contains at most ten Think regions and edits one region for all its hits
Dragging a send during playback keeps the running source timeline
Single HTML contains every engine and executable regression check
File MD5 uses the standard digest, including empty and UTF-8 inputs
